trigger: In the ration line. Wren is lifting cards.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Hour two of the line. Someone's ration card vanishes from a coat pocket. Fast hands. A hoodie.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Sparky! Pharmacy lady! Small world. Small, hungry world.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Oh, look. The robber. How's my insulin?

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: What. You're staring. Stare at the line, it's moving. Kind of.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A guard shoves through. 'Hoodie! Hands out. Somebody's card walked.'

choices.text: She was with me the whole time.

nodes.speaker: authority_guard
nodes.text: Then you can both lose your place. Back of the line.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: ...You're a weird one. I'll remember. I actually remember stuff.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Hey. Registry lady asks about your street? Don't give her names. Names stick.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: They drag her out of line. She doesn't fight. She just looks at you.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: She drops the card in the snow and walks off whistling. The guard gives up.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Then a shout from the front: 'NO MORE FLOUR!' The line breaks like ice.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A boy, maybe eight, goes down between the barriers. Boots everywhere.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You get a hand on his collar. Someone's knee hits your ribs. You haul him up.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: His mother grabs him. Harbor pin on her coat. 'I'm Rosa. I owe you. I owe you.'

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The line re-forms. There was flour. The rumor was wrong.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You get clear. When it settles, the boy is up, crying, alive. You didn't help.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: There was flour. The rumor was wrong.
